steps.caption: Cherry runs supervised work on your own computer. Give it a goal; it plans, runs and checks the work, and comes back to you for the decisions.
The numbers on the page are the run’s own: two tasks, two separate work areas, 34.5 seconds in parallel, two checks passed.
The claim, stated so you can attack it: two agents ran one job, and neither of them could publish it.
Every step of the run is on the record — what ran, where, and what it produced.
Publishing stops at a human decision. No agent tool can make it.
Open Agent View with a WebMCP host attached: Cherry has registered eleven site tools for this page.
The aperture is state-aware. Seven tools are always on; at most five more appear, and only when the state earns them.
These are the live registrations and the real call log — the closures themselves, not a description of them.
Every host row says what was actually observed. ChatGPT desktop in Work mode is Validated because a real session did it.
